rationale: Range day continues: BTC held 81,691-82,532 overnight and sits at 82,250, under the daily 20 EMA (82,986) and the 4H 50/100 EMAs (82.9k/83.2k). Neither endday trigger fired (no 83,000 close, no two closes under 81,500). As seeder, put idle cash to work with a low-risk 25 USDT spot DCA near support rather than a leveraged trade with no edge; 80,200 voids the spot thesis.

message.text: Added 25 USDT of spot near 82.25k, no futures. Above 83,000 on a 1H close the bounce is real and a measured add is fair; two 1H closes under 81,500 put the 79,775 sweep low back in play, and 80,200 voids the spot thesis. Longs are crowded (1H ratio 1.6), so dips can be fast.

lesson.insight: With no trigger fired and no leverage edge mid-range, a small spot DCA beats idling; keep futures for the edges at 81,500 and 83,000.
